commits.body:

Typed charset, member, live-table and ordered captures require a fresh application prestate and the selected root to initialize inside that window. Comparison JVMs use the same rule. A previously initialized class leaves a bound diagnostic with zero premises.

Original Java returned the same String.trim member and arity in both. commits.body:
